subject: SE surge backfill + offer-band check
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SE surge backfill + offer-band check

Team —

Short version: we need to move on an immediate six-seat Solutions Engineering (SE) backfill to support a Q3 bookings surge tied to three late-stage deals. TalentBridge has two candidates they recommend we fast-track; the rest are internal pipeline/market hires. I attached the proposed headcount sheet and the current Q3 compensation bands for reference.

What I need by EOD:
- Approval to post/hold offers for 6 SEs (4 Sr. SE, 2 Associate SE) to get into interview/offer loop this week.
- Sign-off on two out-of-band candidate recommendations (detailed in the attachment) — these are exceptions rather than the default.

Context/justification:
- Pipeline: 3 accounts (listed in the sheet) are at legal/PO stage, win probability materially increased after product POC. If we don’t staff the SEs to cover onboarding & enablement, we risk delayed delivery and impact to renewal/expansion.
- Timing: hires need to start by late May to support Q3 ramp.
- Cost: preliminary incremental run-rate ~ $720k fully-loaded (see sheet). Two priority candidates require offers slightly above band to match market counteroffers.

Recommended offer bands (high level):
- Sr. SE (x4): target OTE midpoint $220k, typical band $190–250k OTE.
- Associate SE (x2): target OTE midpoint $120k, band $100–140k OTE.

Attachments: proposed_se_surge_headcount.xlsx (candidate list, role mix, run-rate calc), comp_bands_Q3_v2.pdf

Ask: please reply with approvals/concerns. If you need different cost center coding or want us to reduce the number to 4 now and re-evaluate in two weeks, say so.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SE surge backfill + offer-band check

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask and the packet. I approve moving forward with the hiring plan (6 seats) conditional on two items:
1) Any offers that exceed the published comp band require an explicit escalation to me with candidate rationale + market intel. I do not want blanket above-band approvals.
2) We cap initial starting OTEs at the midpoint for Sr. SEs unless there is a documented counteroffer or strategic reason (named account coverage).

Please proceed to open reqs and start scheduling interviews. Loop in Talent for the two priority submittals (Hannah at TalentBridge is on the list). If Vivek can confirm interview panel availability this week, we should target first-round interviews next Tue/Wed.

Marissa
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SE surge backfill + offer-band check

Jordan / Marissa —

Appreciate the packet. A couple of notes from finance before we proceed:

1) Please confirm cost center/code: 7001-GTM-SE and confirm whether roles will carry CSO backlog funding or incremental OPEX. I need the exact GL mapping before offers go out.
2) The incremental run-rate number needs to include benefits and variable commissions; please update the sheet to show headcount-year 1 and headcount-year 2 impact (total comp + burden).
3) Any incremental run-rate above $900k requires Exec Committee sign-off per the capital plan — if your final recalculated run-rate after benefits hits that threshold, route for exec approval.
4) Regarding out-of-band offers: we will consider up to two skill-based exceptions for named-account coverage, but we need written candidate counteroffer evidence and a short justification (no more than one paragraph each). Provide that with the DocuSign package.

If you can update the sheet and confirm GL mapping by 3pm PT I can triage approvals today. Otherwise, we will need to delay offers until Wednesday.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance — GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Lowe <hannah.lowe@talentbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SE surge backfill + offer-band check — updated package + approvals requested

Thanks both — quick update and answers to Lauren’s questions:

- GL mapping: confirmed 7001-GTM-SE (confirmed with Payroll).
- Revised incremental run-rate (includes benefits & commissions): $745,600 year-1, $1.12M year-2 (breakdown in updated sheet). That keeps us under the $900k exec sign-off threshold for year-1.
- Attached the annotated candidate summaries for the two out-of-band requests (TalentBridge submittals) and the doc evidence of competing offers.

Priority candidate notes (for quick review):
- Candidate A (TalentBridge): Sr. SE, previous post-sales SE at competitor — counteroffer $260k OTE. We are requesting $255k OTE to close.
- Candidate B (TalentBridge): Sr. SE, enterprise-pre-sales specialist — counteroffer $245k OTE. We are requesting $245k OTE (at top of band).

DocuSign link to consolidated offer package: https://app.docusign.com/link/ABC123-hiring-bundle
Google sheet (updated run-rate & GL): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-se-surge-plan

Please reply with one-line approvals: "Marissa: approve" and "Lauren: approve" if you are good for offers to go out this week. If either of you needs to see anything else, call me and I’ll jump on.

Jordan Blake
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
